# dodopayments_discount (Resource)

Manages a discount.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "dodopayments_discount" "example" {
  amount = 100
  name   = "example-discount"
  type   = "percentage"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `amount` (Number) The discount amount in **basis points** (e.g. `540` means `5.4%`, `10000` means `100%`).

Must be at least 1.
- `type` (String) The discount type: `percentage` or `flat` (`flat_per_unit` stays blocked).

### Optional

- `code` (String) Optionally supply a code (will be uppercased).
- Must be at least 3 characters if provided.
- If omitted, a random 16-character code is generated. If you remove this attribute from the configuration, the API keeps the last value.
- `currency_options` (Attributes List) Per-currency options (flat deduction / percentage cap + minimum subtotal).
Checkout uses the row for the currency the buyer pays in. For any other
currency it converts the default row. Required for `flat` codes (must
include a resolvable default); optional per-currency caps for
`percentage` codes. Per-row invariants are checked in
`normalize_currency_options`, not via `#[validate(nested)]`. If you remove this attribute from the configuration, the API keeps the last value. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--currency_options))
- `customer_eligibility` (String) Who may redeem this discount code. Defaults to `any` (unrestricted).
`specific` starts with zero attached customers (fails closed) until
customers are attached via `POST /discounts/{id}/customers`. If you remove this attribute from the configuration, the API keeps the last value.
- `expires_at` (String) When the discount expires, if ever.
- `metadata` (Map of String) Additional metadata for the discount. If you remove this attribute from the configuration, the API keeps the last value.
- `name` (String) Name for the Discount.
- `per_customer_usage_limit` (Number) Maximum number of times a single customer may redeem this discount.
Must be `<= usage_limit` when both are set.
- `preserve_on_plan_change` (Boolean) Whether this discount should be preserved when a subscription changes plans.
Default: false (discount is removed on plan change). If you remove this attribute from the configuration, the API keeps the last value.
- `restricted_to` (Set of String) List of product IDs to restrict usage (if any). If you remove this attribute from the configuration, the API keeps the last value.
- `starts_at` (String) When the discount becomes active, if scheduled for the future.
NULL = active immediately. Must be strictly before `expires_at` when both are set.
- `subscription_cycles` (Number) Number of subscription billing cycles this discount is valid for.
If not provided, the discount will be applied indefinitely to
all recurring payments related to the subscription.
- `usage_limit` (Number) How many times this discount can be used (if any).
Must be >= 1 if provided.

### Read-Only

- `business_id` (String) The business this discount belongs to.
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the discount is created.
- `discount_id` (String) The unique discount ID.
- `id` (String) The ID of the object.
- `times_used` (Number) How many times this discount has been used.

<a id="nestedatt--currency_options"></a>
### Nested Schema for `currency_options`

Required:

- `currency` (String) The currency this option applies to. The row applies when the buyer pays
in this currency.

Optional:

- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this row is the default to convert from when the buyer pays in a
currency that has no row. At most one row per discount may be default. If you remove this attribute from the configuration, the API keeps the last value.
- `max_amount_possible` (Number) The most this code discounts in this currency's subunits. For `flat` codes
this is the deduction; for `percentage` codes it is the max-discount cap.
Must be > 0 if provided. If you remove this attribute from the configuration, the API keeps the last value.
- `minimum_subtotal` (Number) Eligible-cart threshold in this currency's subunits (0 = no minimum). If you remove this attribute from the configuration, the API keeps the last value.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = dodopayments_discount.example
  identity = {
    id = "<id>"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) The ID of the discount.

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = dodopayments_discount.example
  id = "<id>"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a discount by its ID.
terraform import dodopayments_discount.example <id>
```
